name: Elicit
short_description: AI research assistant that searches papers, runs systematic reviews and extracts data into tables.
notes: Annual: Pro $588/yr, Scale $2,028/yr. API listed on Pro and Enterprise; Scale API not explicit. Research Agent limited on free plan.

name: Consensus
short_description: AI academic search engine that answers questions with evidence synthesized from peer-reviewed papers.
notes: Prices from consensus.app/home/pricing/ (main /pricing/ page is JS-rendered); third-party sites cite higher prices ($15-$45), so this vendor page may be outdated or show annual-equivalent rates. Premium $108/yr, Teams $120/seat/yr. Search API marked 'Coming Soon'.

name: SciSpace Agent
short_description: Research agent that runs literature reviews, paper chat and academic writing tasks on a credit system.
notes: Prices from vendor credits guide (scispace.com/resources/credits-pricing-guide/); /pricing is JS-rendered. Annual-billed: Premium $12/mo, Advanced $70/mo, Max $160/mo. Credits: 100/1,200/10,000/40,000 per month.

name: Scite Assistant
short_description: Research assistant grounded in Smart Citations showing whether papers support or contrast a claim.
notes: Basic and Pro prices shown are per month billed yearly; monthly-billed price not captured. 7-day free trial. API on Pro; MCP credits on all tiers (free tier needs trial or paid plan for MCP).

name: Undermind
short_description: Deep scientific search agent that reads full-text papers to find everything relevant to a complex topic.
notes: Pro $16/mo and Team $15/person/mo are annual-billed rates; monthly-billed Pro price not shown explicitly. MCP connection to Claude/ChatGPT agents supported.

name: Perplexity Deep Research
short_description: Answer engine whose Research mode runs dozens of searches and writes cited multi-page reports.
notes: Prices from /enterprise/pricing (consumer /pro page is JS-rendered). Max consumer plan price not captured; Education Pro $10/mo. Pro: up to 20 Deep Research/month. API is pay-as-you-go (rates not captured).

name: ChatGPT Deep Research
short_description: ChatGPT agent mode that browses the web for minutes and produces cited analyst-style research reports.
notes: chatgpt.com/pricing is JS-rendered; amounts not readable. Plus $20/mo confirmed via help.openai.com. Go/Pro/Business amounts left null. Deep research limited on Free/Go, expanded on Plus, max on Pro. API availability of deep-research models is from general knowledge, not the pricing page.

name: Gemini Deep Research
short_description: Gemini agent that plans, browses hundreds of sites and compiles comprehensive research reports.
notes: Page says Ultra 'starting at $99.99/month' with a $199.99 higher tier. Deep Research included on free tier with limits; higher limits on paid plans. API availability of the Deep Research agent not confirmed on this page.

name: You.com Research API
short_description: API for multi-step search and synthesis returning cited research answers, from lite to exhaustive depth.
notes: $100 free API credit. Research API tiers: Lite, Standard, Deep, Exhaustive, Frontier; $12/1k is the starting tier. MCP server mentioned for Contents API. Free tier: 100 queries/day.

name: Exa
short_description: Search engine API for AI with deep research agent and Websets for finding and enriching lists of entities.

plans.unit: request (Minimal effort; up to $1.00 at X-high)

notes: Free: $10 credits/month + $10 onboarding bonus. Other endpoints: Instant $4/1k, Fast/Auto $7/1k, Contents $1/1k pages, Monitors $15/1k, Answer $5/1k. Websets plan prices not captured; lead/competitor capabilities inferred from Websets/Monitors positioning - verify.

name: Parallel Task API
short_description: Web research API whose Task processors run deep research and enrichment jobs returning structured, cited output.
notes: Up to 5,000 free requests/month; up to $80 at signup + $5/month free credits. Processors range $5-$2,400 per 1k. Also Search ($1-5/1k), Extract ($1/1k), Monitor, FindAll APIs.

name: Tavily
short_description: Search, extract and research API built for AI agents, with a research endpoint producing cited reports.
notes: Free: 1,000 credits/month. Project/Bootstrap/Startup/Growth amounts from docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits (pricing page uses slider). Research endpoint: 4-250 credits/request. MCP not mentioned on pricing page.

name: Manus
short_description: General autonomous agent that researches, browses and builds deliverables like reports, slides and sites.
notes: Vendor pricing page is JS-rendered; amounts from third-party nocode.mba (Sep 2026) - unverified. Free: 300 daily refresh credits; Pro $20 = 4,000 credits; ~17% annual discount. Capabilities from general product knowledge; verify.

name: Genspark Super Agent
short_description: All-in-one super agent that researches and produces reports, slides, sheets and can make calls.
notes: /pricing blocked by robots.txt; prices from vendor's /business/pricing. Annual: Plus $19.99/mo, Pro $199.99/mo. Free 100 credits/day. Capability list from general product knowledge - verify.

name: GPT Researcher
short_description: Open-source autonomous agent that researches any topic online and writes detailed cited reports.
notes: Apache 2.0, ~29.5k stars, actively maintained. Costs are your own LLM/search API usage. MCP integration for data sources.

name: STORM
short_description: Open-source research system that writes Wikipedia-style cited articles via multi-perspective questioning.
notes: MIT, ~30.8k stars. Last notable release Jan 2025 (v1.1.0) - maintenance activity lower; academic project. Free hosted preview at storm.genie.stanford.edu.

name: Kosmos
short_description: AI scientist agent that reads papers and analyzes datasets for hours to produce cited discovery reports.
notes: Spin-out of FutureHouse. Free: 10 credits/month, standard agents. Founding Kosmos: 650 credits/month. Free 650 credits for academics (.edu). API not detailed on pricing page. Code Generation/Data Analysis inferred from 'code and citations' positioning.

name: Crayon
short_description: Competitive intelligence platform that monitors competitors, scores insights with AI and builds battlecards.
notes: No public pricing ('Request an Estimate'). Integrations with Salesforce, Slack, Highspot.

name: Klue Compete Agent
short_description: Competitive intelligence and win-loss platform with agents that collect, curate and share competitor intel.
notes: No public pricing (demo/sales). Agents: Compete Agent, Win & Loss Story Agent, AI Interviewer (voice conversations with buyers).

name: AlphaSense
short_description: Market intelligence platform with AI search, summarization and workflow agents over 500M+ documents.
notes: No public pricing. 'Get Started for Free' CTA suggests a trial; length not stated. Competitor Monitoring inferred from market intelligence positioning.

name: Firecrawl
short_description: Web data API that crawls, scrapes and extracts sites into LLM-ready markdown or JSON, with an agent mode.
notes: Credits: 1k/5k/100k/500k/1M per month. Annual: $16/$83/$333/$599. Agent in preview (5 free daily runs). MCP server documented on vendor docs (not on pricing page). Repo formerly mendableai/firecrawl (AGPL core).

name: Browse AI
short_description: No-code robots that extract and monitor data from any website, with change alerts and integrations.
notes: Annual: Personal $19/mo, Professional $69/mo (page says 20% discount though numbers differ more). Premium 'starting at' $500/mo. Free 50 credits/month.

name: Apify
short_description: Cloud platform of 'Actors' for web scraping and browser automation that AI agents can call via MCP.
notes: Plans include equal usage credits plus overage; CU $0.20 (Free/Starter), $0.16 (Scale), $0.13 (Business). Supports x402 agentic payments. Crawlee is Apify's open-source library but platform itself is not open source. Lead Generation from Actor store positioning - verify.

name: Bright Data
short_description: Web data platform with unlocker, scraper APIs, agent browser and MCP server for AI agents.
notes: All 'starts from' prices; Scraper APIs promo $0.75 (from $1). Free tiers on Unlocker, SERP, Scraper Studio and MCP. Retail Insights from $2,000/mo.

name: Browserbase + Stagehand
short_description: Headless browser cloud with the Stagehand agent framework for AI browser automation and extraction.
notes: Browser hours 1/100/500; overage $0.12/$0.10 per hour. Agent runs 3/15/50 included. Stagehand is open source; Browserbase cloud is not. MCP listed in nav but not detailed.

name: Browser Use
short_description: Open-source and cloud agent that controls a web browser to complete tasks and extract data.
notes: $15 one-time free credits on eligible signup; $5 min top-up; credits never expire. Proxy $5/GB residential. Computer Use mapping is loose (browser-only).

name: Crawl4AI
short_description: Open-source crawler that turns websites into LLM-ready markdown and structured data via LLM extraction.
notes: Apache 2.0, ~84.5k stars, v0.9.4 released 2026-09-23. README references cloud instances; no public cloud pricing found.

name: ScrapeGraphAI
short_description: LLM-powered scraping API and open-source library that extracts structured data from sites via prompts.
notes: Free = 500 one-time credits. Credits 10k/100k/750k per month. Monitors included (1/5/25/100). MCP not confirmed on pricing page.

name: Kadoa
short_description: AI agents that build and maintain web scrapers automatically and deliver structured data feeds.
notes: Consumption-based; no public amounts. Free/no-commitment evaluation period. MCP, Snowflake, S3 integrations listed on Enterprise.

name: AgentQL
short_description: Query language and API that lets AI agents locate elements and extract structured data from any web page.
notes: Trial: 300 free calls. Starter $0/mo with 50 calls then $0.02/call. Professional: 10k calls, $0.015/call overage. MCP not mentioned on pricing page. Company attribution to TinyFish from general knowledge.

name: Reducto
short_description: Document parsing and extraction API that turns complex PDFs and spreadsheets into structured, cited data.
notes: $150 free usage on Standard. Deep Extract $40/1k pages, Classify $7.50/1k. Borderline 'agent' - included as document-data extraction agent.

name: Julius AI
short_description: AI data analyst that connects to files and databases to run analyses, charts and reports in plain English.
notes: Annual: $16/$37/$166/$375 per month. Connectors: Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL on paid plans. Forecasting from general product knowledge - verify.

name: Hex Agent
short_description: Data notebook and BI workspace with an AI agent that writes SQL/Python and builds analyses.
notes: Billing interval (monthly vs annual) for per-editor prices not stated. Team has 14-day trial. REST API on Team/Enterprise. Community has only an agent trial.

name: Vanna AI
short_description: Text-to-SQL agent that answers questions about your database, available as open source or hosted.
notes: 20% off annual. Explorer 20 questions/day, Team 300/day.

name: Wren AI
short_description: GenBI agent that turns natural-language questions into SQL, charts and dashboards over a semantic layer.
notes: Essential/Enterprise Cloud prices are per month billed annually. Overage $0.10/credit. MCP on Enterprise Cloud and above; API on Essential+. Open-source CLI/context engine on GitHub.

name: Databricks Genie
short_description: AI/BI agent that answers natural-language questions over governed Databricks data with SQL.
notes: Pricing table did not render. Page states free usage applies to Genie LLM usage only; compute billed separately in DBUs. 14-day Databricks free trial.

name: Snowflake Cortex Analyst

notes: Cortex Analyst billed per 1,000 messages and Cortex Agents per million tokens in AI Credits; credits-per-unit rates are in the Service Consumption Table (not captured). Free trial referenced on product page.

name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
short_description: Agentic analytics platform where Spotter answers data questions in natural language and builds insights.
notes: Essentials/Pro prices are per user/month billed annually. MCP on Pro and Enterprise. Embedded Developer free for 1 year with REST API. Forecasting from general product knowledge - verify.

name: Powerdrill Bloom
short_description: AI data analysis agent that explores uploaded files and open data to produce insights and reports.
notes: Amounts are regular prices shown as monthly; page also shows 20% promo ($13.27/$26.60/$132.67) and yearly $199/$399/$1,990 (equal to 12x regular) - billing interval ambiguous. Free: 1,000 daily credits.

name: Fabi.ai
short_description: AI analyst agent and SQL/Python notebooks for self-serve analysis and automated reports.
notes: Builder $39/mo billed monthly; yearly price not shown. MCP (OAuth) listed as feature, tier availability unclear. SQL Querying from product positioning.
